summary: Frontend-only e2e testing of iteration 2 features on Perlae Atelier: editorial hero, Atelier 3D interactive section, product page 3D viewer toggle, Artisane page hero, floating pill navbar + mobile menu, and regression smoke on Boutique/Panier. All targeted flows pass with no React or Three.js console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: hero-mini-card-* data-testid appears to be on a wrapper (not on the <a> element itself) — getAttribute('href') returned null. Cards still render 6 items and are clickable, but for stronger automation put data-testid directly on the <Link>.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 verified fully. Home hero (hero-section, CTAs, social-proof, featured product add-to-cart triggers cart-drawer + cart-count-badge=1, 6 hero-mini-card-* links), Atelier 3D (canvas mounts on scroll into view, shape/accent toggles keep canvas alive, atelier-custom-cta href='/contact'), Product /produit/cabas-fleur-de-soleil and /produit/parure-ambre 3D toggle + viewer-accent-* all render a <canvas> with no errors, switching back to Photo restores product-main-image. Artisane page hero + boutique/contact CTAs + gallery visible. Navbar cart-drawer-toggle opens drawer; at 390px mobile-menu-toggle opens mobile-menu. No console errors observed. Regression smoke on /panier renders the form (test's programmatic add-to-cart on boutique via text selector did not persist into panier; iter-1 already validated that flow at 100%).
